subject: Interested in Hosted API eval

From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@bytecart.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-07T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Interested in Hosted API eval

Hi Ben,

We just spun up a trial via your self-serve flow and want to line up a short walkthrough of the Hosted API for our ML/infra team. Primary goals: validate latency on short requests (<= 50ms target), see workspace/sandbox, and confirm cost profile for embeddings-heavy flows.

Available windows this week: Tue/Wed 10:00–12:00 PT, Thu afternoon after 1pm PT. Timezone: San Francisco (PST).

Also CC'ing Sam (PM) who will join. Can you share a quick checklist of anything we should pre-provision?

Thanks,
Alex

--
Alex Wu
Senior ML Engineer, ByteCart
alex.wu@bytecart.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@bytecart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-07T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Hosted API eval

Alex — great to meet you, and congrats on getting started with the trial.

I'm available Tue 11:00–11:45 PT or Wed 10:30–11:15 PT. If neither works we can do Thu 13:30 PT. I'll leave the definitive slot to you.

Preflight checklist (short):
- Confirm API key in your trial workspace (Settings > API keys)
- Share a sample prompt/embedding workload (1–2 examples)
- If you need sandbox access, we'll provision a temp key and a tiny dataset to simulate latency.

I've attached a one-pager with preflight steps (hostedapi-preflight.md) and a short sandbox access token stub (sandbox-access.txt) — I'll provision real creds after we lock a time.

If you want a calendar link instead of back-and-forth, here's my public Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-hostedapi-eval.

Best,
Ben
Enterprise SDR, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachments: hostedapi-preflight.md (text/markdown), sandbox-access.txt (text/plain)
From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@bytecart.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Samantha Green <sam.green@bytecart.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T23:05:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Hosted API eval

Ben — quick heads up: Sam is in London (GMT) and I just hopped on a call with infra; the Tue/Wed slots I originally listed were PST for me but might be late for Sam.

Would either Wed 18:00 GMT (Wed 10:00 PT) or Thu 18:30 GMT (Thu 11:30 PT) work for you? If not, we can pick a shorter 20-min sync and follow with a technical sandbox handoff document.

Also — curious whether you support EU-hosted runtime for performance testing (we have compliance constraints, might want EU region later).

Appreciate the preflight doc, I'll forward any sample prompts by EOD tomorrow.

—Alex
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@bytecart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-08T08:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Hosted API eval

Alex — thanks for the timezone callout; appreciate the heads-up. Wed 18:00 GMT (Wed 10:00 PT) works for me — I'll hold 10:00–10:30 PT as a 30-minute slot and we can extend if needed. Marissa from our solutions team will join to run the sandbox demo.

Short answers:
- EU runtime: yes, we can route requests to eu-central for testing; we can also run a quick cross-region latency comparison during the session.
- 20-min option: fine — we'll keep the first 15 for a demo and 10 for Q&A.

I'll send a calendar invite with a brief agenda and a link to the sandbox workspace (temp creds to follow once the invite is accepted).

Agenda (proposed):
1) 3–5 min intros and goals
2) 10–12 min quick sandbox walk: generation + embedding latency checks
3) 5–8 min next steps and provisioning

Thanks — sending invite now.

Best,
Ben
